term: actual direct supporter of another individual's existence
definition: PresentEsseSupport m R w₀ c b holds when c exists at the selected actual world and the separate primitive R records c as a direct existential supporter of b there. No c ≠ b condition is built into the raw relation; a well-founded support order rules out actual self-support. R is not identified with generic Ontic.Causes, the transmission of power, temporal production, or an adequate explanatory reason.
note: A source-free typed model for #495. DEF-EXISTENTIAL-SUPPORT-MODEL additionally requires distinct actual individuals and so cannot be reused as an exact synonym. Whether real existential grounding admits this abstraction remains open. Five-question interpretation audit: docs/power-existence-scope-boundary.md, section Five questions for direct existential support (#680, #686). Intended reading: an actual cause of this very bearer's being, not merely its activity or state; this is an open interpretation, not a predicate-body definition. No undisputed empirical bearer-existence exemplar is currently supplied. Physical sustaining examples do not alone license the abstraction. Target presence, causal correspondence, asymmetry, transitivity (especially problematic for direct support), actual/union well-foundedness and necessity inheritance require separate justification; no such properties are automatically assumed.
